hints.title: Locating the Unique Master Root
hints.text: The root of the final combined tree must be a tree root that never appears as a leaf in any other tree.

hints.title: Recursive Leaf Expansion
hints.text: Traverse the master root; whenever encountering a leaf node whose value matches another tree root, splice that tree into place.

hints.title: Validating Global Binary Search Invariant
hints.text: Ensure the merged tree strictly satisfies min and max key boundaries and accounts for all input trees.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total nodes across all trees
complexity.notes: Leaf collection, root identification, and recursive BST range validation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all permutations of tree mergers takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since each leaf value in a valid BST must be unique, the root candidate is uniquely determined in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that only the single tree root absent from all leaf sets can be the merged tree root.
